#### Description

- Refactor `Scale()` to accept volume factor as a parameter to adjust volume on TradeBars, ask size & bid size on QuoteBars, and Quantity of Trade Ticks
- Update callers with appropriate volume factor
- Update all regressions affected (+ a couple altered by #5493)

#### Motivation and Context
<!--- Why is this change required? What problem does it solve? -->
Volume was not adjusted for TradeBars and Trade Ticks when handling price scaling because of split factors. This PR provides a fix that corrects the issue.

issue_context.title: Volume is not adjusted for splits
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->

Volume should be adjusted for splits when using `DataNormalizationMode.SplitAdjusted`

#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->

Volume is not adjusted for splits.

#### Potential Solution
<!--- Optional. Describe any potential solutions and/or thoughts as to what may be causing the difference between expected and actual behavior. -->

Dividing volume by PriceScaleFactor of that day seems to fix the volume.
For e.g. PriceScaleFactor of TSLA before the split was 0.2 and 19M / 0.2 yields 95M which is the correct volume. This should work for reverse splits as well.

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->

Run the backtest [here](https://www.quantconnect.com/terminal/processCache?request=embedded_backtest_fd2bac140c77e4d7704beccb2bf58f3c.html)

Reverse split example [here](https://www.quantconnect.com/terminal/processCache?request=embedded_backtest_b51631c3e9c003fda8ec983f6f1a5fb8.html)

#### System Information
<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
QC Cloud
